description: Browse the Wikibooks Cookbook by cuisine, by kind of dish, or by main ingredient. Give at least one of the three; giving several narrows the result. This is built on the Cookbook's search, because the route this server is allowed to use publishes no way to list the members of a category. What comes back is therefore a ranked sample and not the category itself: it is neither complete nor ordered, and its length says nothing about how many recipes the Cookbook holds on the subject. The Cookbook also holds reference pages on ingredients and techniques, and those rank alongside recipes. Open a row with get_recipe before describing it as a recipe. Use search_recipes instead when there is a dish name to look up.

cuisine.description: A cuisine or a country, such as 'Italian' or 'Thai'.

dish_type.description: A kind of dish, such as 'soup', 'dessert' or 'bread'.

main_ingredient.description: The ingredient a recipe is built on, such as 'chicken' or 'lentils'.

name: list_recipes

query.description: The search this server built from the arguments.

description.description: The short gloss the wiki keeps for the page.

excerpt.description: The matching passage, with highlight markup removed.

id.description: Page key. Pass this to get_recipe.

image_url.description: Thumbnail the search offered, when it offered one.

url.description: Public page. Show this when citing the recipe.

total_available.description: Always null: no route reports how many recipes a category holds.

title: Browse the Cookbook
